name: Cloudflare
tagline: Edge compute, DNS, storage, workers, AI, and official MCP servers.
shortDescription: Cloudflare exposes broad API, Wrangler CLI, Workers, Pages, R2, KV, D1, Vectorize, AI, and MCP servers.
agentSummary: Agents can deploy Workers, manage DNS, inspect analytics, provision storage, and connect through Cloudflare MCP servers.
bestFor: Edge deployment, DNS, Workers, storage, observability, and agent infrastructure.
cautionNotes: Key limitations: DNS, firewall, and production deployment changes need explicit human approval. Model behavior, costs, rate limits, data retention, and safety policies can change by model and account tier; use evals, spend caps, and data controls for sensitive workloads. MCP servers inherit the connected account's scopes and may send prompts or data to third-party services; configure read-only or narrow scopes when available. CLI access is powerful but can run destructive local or production commands; prefer dry runs, preview environments, and non-production credentials.
pricingSummary: Public pricing across plans and usage-based developer products.
authModel: API tokens with scoped permissions, OAuth, account IDs, and Wrangler login.
browserSupport: Dashboard is important for account, DNS, logs, and billing review.
